name: dev-kit
description: Small everyday development skills: diagnose and fix failed CI pipelines, shepherd a pull request until CI is green and review is resolved, check a dependency upgrade against the codebase, and push a branch as a pull request filled from the repository's template and labelled with its risk, assessed by TypeSafe Jev, Gemini Decision or both.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key for the Jev risk assessment. Leave empty to read TYPESAFE_API_KEY; with neither set, no diff is sent anywhere.

typesafe_endpoint.title: TypeSafe endpoint
typesafe_endpoint.description: Base URL of the TypeSafe API

typesafe_model.title: Jev model
typesafe_model.description: Model name or alias, such as jev-latest or jev-1.14.0

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Gemini Developer API key for Gemini Decision. Leave empty to read GEMINI_DECISIONS_API_KEY, then GEMINI_API_KEY.

decision_backend.title: Decision backend
decision_backend.description: Which model answers the risk assessment: auto uses the one key that is set and asks when both are; both runs TypeSafe and Gemini side by side and logs the pair for comparison.

primary_backend.title: Primary backend
primary_backend.description: With both backends, the one whose answer is used for the risk assessment; the other is shown beside it.

risk_label.title: Risk label
risk_label.description: Add a risk label to the pull request pr-open opens

risk_label_name.title: Risk label name
risk_label_name.description: Label name; {level} is replaced by the risk level

risk_levels.title: Risk levels
risk_levels.description: Names of the four risk levels, from lowest to highest
